exposure: Internal iliac intravascular occlusive balloon catheter placement
outcome: Adverse outcomes (intensive care unit admission, thromboembolism, ureteral stent placement, amputation, or reoperation)
cohort: 34 adult women who underwent a planned cesarean hysterectomy between 2004 and 2019
finding: Balloon placement, regardless of deployment, was associated with higher estimated blood loss, transfusion requirements, and adverse outcomes in women undergoing planned cesarean hysterectomy.
